entries.headline: Expanded Stylist AI into an interactive wardrobe and shopping experience
entries.summary: Built a tool-calling stylist shared by text and hands-free voice, with wardrobe search, weather-aware outfit creation, saved looks, and Shopify shopping. Added multi-look outfit boards, inspiration-photo matching, shopping details, calendar-aware styling, and an interactive outfit stage with alternates and slot-by-slot swapping.

entries.headline: Improved wardrobe ingestion and product variant selection
entries.summary: Added transparent garment cutouts for cleaner wardrobe presentation and updated Shopify selection to account for store-specific size labels, requested colours, and available inventory before checkout.

entries.headline: Merged browser-click v1 Chrome extension
entries.summary: Delivered a Chrome MV3 extension that lets users select part of a page and ask Claude about it in an in-page panel. The v1 includes frozen-screen selection, page context, streamed answers, follow-ups, additional selections, web search, settings, and inline error recovery without a backend or telemetry.
